content: {"episode_id":"ep-05070","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered to evaluate potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms and assess any correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and the patient's neurological history. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 bundling denial in light of this documented clinical indication."}
